high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "motherboardvice." The post features a headline that reads: "The US Carefully Documented Its Total Failure in Afghanistan for 12 Years." Below the headline, there is a subheading stating: "For 12 years, the Special Inspector General for Afghanistan issued grim and detailed reports about America's failures in the country. No one listened." The author of the article is credited as Matthew Gault. The main visual element of the post is a photograph showing a Kam Air Airbus A340 aircraft parked on an airport tarmac.
